author: agent
objective: Among residents of the 96 mainland French departments, what was the adjusted association between department-level long-term mean PM2.5 (1999–2016) and cumulative in-hospital COVID-19 death counts/rates on 1 May 2020?

scientific_invariants.research_question: Among residents of the 96 mainland French departments, what was the adjusted association between department-level long-term mean PM2.5 (1999–2016) and cumulative in-hospital COVID-19 death counts/rates on 1 May 2020?
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: Cumulative in-hospital COVID-19 deaths through 2020-05-01 among residents of 96 mainland French departments; count model with department population offset.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Rate ratio per 1 µg/m³ increase in department-level long-term mean PM2.5
principal_variants: Adjusted continuous-PM2.5 negative-binomial model at 1 May 2020 with population offset
Article-reported adjusted PM2.5-quartile model (Q2/Q3/Q4 vs Q1) at 1 May 2020
prohibited_evidence: Prior reanalysis code, source manifests, or results

article_evidence.finding: Methods report 96 mainland departments, 1999–2016 GOME/NASA SEDAC 1-km PM2.5 aggregated by department, cumulative hospital COVID deaths, and fully adjusted negative-binomial models.
Supplementary material is retained for inspection of article-linked tabular supporting information; any PM2.5 fields will be excluded from fitted data.

article_evidence_map.model: article.txt Statistical analysis and Table 3: PM2.5 and temperature together; beds, medical density, age 60+, male share, unemployment, poverty, urban population, density and diabetes.
article_evidence_map.discrepancy: The study target omitted some article-listed covariates; article controls the full adjustment set.

execution_design.geographic_representation: 96 geoBoundaries France ADM2 department polygons (official IGN source stated in GeoBoundaries metadata); all mainland departments.
execution_design.assignment_method: Unweighted zonal mean over every valid 0.01-degree PM2.5 grid cell whose center falls in each department polygon; no monitor assignment.
execution_design.source_strategy: NASA Earthdata ImageServer public multidimensional Global Annual PM2.5 Grids (V4.GL.03), explicitly selecting each 1999–2016 annual slice; WorldClim v2.1 BIO1 used for temperature adjustment.
execution_design.exposure_metric: Arithmetic mean of 18 department annual PM2.5 zonal means, 1999–2016, µg/m³.
execution_design.analysis_aggregation: Department-level 18-year arithmetic mean; 18/18 annual raster slices observed for every department.
execution_design.coverage_policy: Report-only: retain departments with all 18 valid annual PM2.5 means. WorldClim 10-arcminute cell containing the centroid is used only for Paris because its polygon contains no 10-arcminute cell center.
execution_design.intended_use: Continuous PM2.5 and PM2.5 quartile terms in article-aligned negative-binomial mortality-count models with a log population offset.

evidence.finding: NASA ImageServer metadata identifies the public global annual PM2.5 raster service, WGS84, 0.01-degree pixels, annual temporal dimension.
Independent zonal processing yielded 18/18 annual PM2.5 values for each of 96 departments; output includes mean/range and temperature coverage.
GeoBoundaries metadata reports France ADM2/Department, official IGN source, and 96 units.

amendments.scientific_justification: This directly implements the article's GOME/NASA SEDAC 1999–2016 department-level spatial mean construct using a maintained public NASA Earthdata distribution. It does not use author-published PM2.5 values. The covariate temperature source is a WorldClim climatology rather than the article-stated 2001–2012 aggregation, so that covariate substitution is declared separately.
